title: A race between overlapping patterns
hook: Two stated cases: explore the suffix state in first-pattern arrival.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the suffix state in first-pattern arrival affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines BFirst, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the suffix state in first-pattern arrival in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Race two 3-flip patterns on a fair coin. A is code 0, B code 4, in binary with H=0,T=1. What probability does B finish first, iterated through 300 steps?
